snippet.title: B-e-e-t-l-e: be right back! - Official Wishlist Trailer | Six One Indie Showcase May 2026
snippet.description: Get a look at the Wishlist Trailer for B-e-e-t-l-e: be right back!, a typing adventure game developed by Paul and Viv. Players will explore a vibrant world where every keystroke brings the world to life as you search for your lost beetle - encounter a wacky cast of characters, crack puzzles and discover whimsical surprises along the way. B-e-e-t-l-e: be right back! is coming soon to PC (Steam).
